mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.operator_id

SELECT l.id, l.operator_id, COALESCE(u.username, '系统') AS operator_name, COALESCE(u.role, 'SYSTEM') AS operator_role, l.operation_type, l.action, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.target, l.reason, l.result, l.create_time FROM operation_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.operator_id
ORDER BY l.create_time DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT l.id, l.operator_id, COALESCE(u.username, '系统') AS operator_name, COALESCE(u.role, 'SYSTEM') AS operator_role, l.operation_type, l.action, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.target, CASE l.target_type WHEN 'DOCTOR' THEN d.name WHEN 'SOURCE' THEN CONCAT(sd.name, ' ', DATE_FORMAT(s.visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ', s.time_period, '号源') WHEN 'REFUND' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(rp.name, '未知患者'), '的退款申请') WHEN 'QUEUE' THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(qp.name, '未知患者'), '的排队记录') ELSE l.target END AS target_name, CASE l.target_type WHEN 'REFUND' THEN ra.id WHEN 'QUEUE' THEN qa.id ELSE NULL END AS appointment_id, CASE l.target_type WHEN 'REFUND' THEN rp.name WHEN 'QUEUE' THEN qp.name ELSE NULL END AS patient_name, CASE l.target_type WHEN 'DOCTOR' THEN d.name WHEN 'SOURCE' THEN sd.name WHEN 'REFUND' THEN rd.name WHEN 'QUEUE' THEN qd.name ELSE NULL END AS doctor_name, CASE l.target_type WHEN 'DOCTOR' THEN CONCAT('医生ID=', d.id, '，账号ID=', d.user_id) WHEN 'SOURCE' THEN CONCAT('号源ID=', s.id, '，出诊=', DATE_FORMAT(s.visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), ' ', s.time_period) WHEN 'REFUND' THEN CONCAT('退款ID=', r.id, '，预约ID=', ra.id, '，患者=', COALESCE(rp.name, '未知'), '，医生=', COALESCE(rd.name, '未知')) WHEN 'QUEUE' THEN CONCAT('队列ID=', q.id, '，预约ID=', qa.id, '，排队号=', q.queue_no, '，患者=', COALESCE(qp.name, '未知'), '，医生=', COALESCE(qd.name, '未知')) ELSE l.target END AS business_info, l.reason, l.result, l.create_time FROM operation_log l LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = l.operator_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON l.target_type = 'DOCTOR' AND d.id = l.target_id LEFT JOIN source s ON l.target_type = 'SOURCE' AND s.id = l.target_id LEFT JOIN doctor sd ON sd.id = s.doctor_id LEFT JOIN refund r ON l.target_type = 'REFUND' AND r.id = l.target_id LEFT JOIN payment rpay ON rpay.id = r.payment_id LEFT JOIN appointment ra ON ra.id = rpay.appointment_id LEFT JOIN patient rp ON rp.id = ra.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor rd ON rd.id = ra.doctor_id LEFT JOIN queue q ON l.target_type = 'QUEUE' AND q.id = l.target_id LEFT JOIN appointment qa ON qa.id = q.appointment_id LEFT JOIN patient qp ON qp.id = qa.patient_id LEFT JOIN doctor qd ON qd.id = qa.doctor_id WHERE l.id = #{id}
